title: Entity Audit Scorecard
short: The 5C rubric as a tool: Clarity, Coverage, Consistency, Connection and Corroboration, scored 0–3 each at page and site level, with a prioritised fix list underneath.
needs: Nothing — it runs entirely in your browser and makes no API calls
inputs: The CSVs the other tools export, or click the built-in example
outputs: A saved scorecard (JSON) and a CSV export
how: Click “Load the MLforSEO baseline” to see a worked example on a real site.
Read the verdict first, then the five-dimension gauge.
Open a dimension card to see the numbers driving that score.
Work the “What to fix, in order” list — it is ranked by impact against effort.
Save the scorecard. It becomes the before state you compare against in 90 days.
note: Saving is the step people skip, and it is the one that turns a report into a measurement.
